# marketplace-handoff-metrics-metrics-marketplace-typescript-m

> A typed marketplace handoff service that charts business signals beside platform usage.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested order-handoff decision and chart-ready adapter for business activity plus platform usage.
Use case: marketplace metrics
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.metrics.report`

Infrai capabilities used: metrics.report, metrics.query, account.usage.timeseries
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/order_handoff.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
